text:
Camille: Quick sync — we need to finalize sequencing for the AcmeModel marketplace listing + GigaChip HW bundle + SI integration. Who owns gating items? :thinking:
Omar: Partnerships owns co-marketing and the announcement timeline. Eng/infra need to confirm SKU + binary hosting readiness.
Sanjay: Eng update: quantized v1.2 passes unit tests on GigaChip in lab. Full perf pass pending. We can't publish marketplace SKU until redistribution rights are explicit.
Liz: Legal — we still need explicit export-control language and a clear "weights hosting allowed" clause from the model provider. Also need provenance statement for training data.
Camille: @Liz what's the minimum clause we can ask for without derailing the partner? We have a partner-requested announce window next week.
Liz: Minimum acceptable: a written grant to host and serve the model binaries commercially, permission to redistribute binaries as part of a HW/software bundle, and attribution. No sublicensing beyond SI partners unless explicitly stated. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum.
Omar: Ops note: marketplace requires SKU, compatibility matrix, and a signed redistribution addendum attached to the listing. I'll prepare the SKU template and open a PR to infra-marketplace.
Sanjay: Can we do a private/sandbox listing first (internal + partner preview) while Legal finishes the addendum? That would let QA and SI work through install flows.
Kate: Marketing timeline: teaser (Day 0), docs/how-to + quickstart (Day 2), joint blog + live demo (Day 7). We need final logos, joint quotes, and a short demo script.
Camille: Partner asked for a 7-day embargo between partner approval and public announce. We need signoffs on legal, security, and HW validation before we lift embargo.
Liz: Also confirm SI vendors have signed PSA/NDA that permit rehosting. If an SI will host model weights on-prem for customers, we need a rehosting addendum.
Camille: Action items (assign): Liz — draft addendum & rehosting clause; Omar — create SKU PR + attach infra checklist; Sanjay — final perf + compatibility matrix; Kate — teaser assets + demo script. Can everyone confirm by COB Tue?
Omar: Confirmed. I'll start the SKU PR now and tag infra.
Sanjay: Confirmed. Final perf run scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Will paste results here.
Kate: Confirmed. Assets in progress; will share preview this afternoon.
Liz: Draft uploaded (drive link: https://drive.google.com/fake-link). Draft includes export control paragraph + attribution language. Camille please review.
Camille: Reviewed, small wording tweak on attribution. Pushed change back to Liz. Also adding day-0 checklist for the sandbox publish:
```
- [ ] Signed addendum from AcmeModel (legal)
- [ ] SI PSA / rehosting addendum signed
- [ ] Marketplace SKU PR merged
- [ ] Compatibility matrix attached (GigaChip variants)
- [ ] Private listing created in sandbox environment
- [ ] Demo script + assets ready for partner review
- [ ] Security checklist (pen test / dependency scan) green
```
Omar: I'll update the PR with the checklist items and set the marketplace listing to private until all boxes checked.
Sanjay: If perf numbers hold, we can also include a "certified quantized variant" badge in the listing to simplify customer expectations.
Kate: Good idea — marketing will use the badge in teaser copy.
deploy-bot: Announcement channel /announce will be reserved for the joint blog post window, tagging @all on publish.
Camille: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene Wed morning if there are blockers. If anyone hits a legal or export-control snag, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
